title: Getting started with the app
summary: Sign in, find Home, and open Help when you need guidance.

blocks.text: This app helps your organisation manage members, donations, meetings, and more. Use this Help portal whenever you need a short walkthrough.

items: Sign in with your organisation account
Open Home from the main navigation
Use More → Help to return here anytime

blocks.text: Search on the Help home page by topic words such as donation or meeting.
